id.description: Global ID of the market region, e.g. gid://shopify/MarketRegionCountry/123 for a whole country or gid://shopify/MarketRegionSubdivision/456 for a country subdivision (state, province).

name.description: Name of the country. For a subdivision region, the name of the country the subdivision belongs to.

code.description: ISO country code. For a subdivision region, the code of the country the subdivision belongs to.

subdivision_name.description: Name of the subdivision (state, province) when the market region is a subdivision, null for whole-country regions.

subdivision_code.description: Code of the subdivision (e.g. CA for California) when the market region is a subdivision, null for whole-country regions.

currency_code.description: Currency used for this country given the market settings. Null for subdivision regions.

market_id.description: Unique identifier of the market the country belongs to.

market_type.description: Type of the market (REGION, LOCATION, COMPANY_LOCATION, NONE).

shipping_enabled.description: Whether shipping is enabled for the market.

shipping_options.description: Shipping options configured for the market and shown to buyers at checkout.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shipping option.

name.description: Name of the shipping option shown to buyers. Not available for carrier-calculated options.

description.description: Description of the shipping option shown to buyers.

currency.description: Currency used for all money values in the shipping option.

is_active.description: Whether the shipping option is active and shown to buyers.

free_delivery_minimum_value.description: Cart subtotal required for free shipping, if set.

shop_url.description: URL for the shop related to this country.
